props.caption: Saudi Arabia reported intercepting a Houthi ballistic missile and drone on Sunday.
Prospector 5 sank offshore Gabon during jacking operations; five people remain unaccounted for.
Serbia opened polling Sunday for a snap parliamentary election.

lead.what: King Khalid International Airport reopened terminals 1 and 2 for domestic and international flights on Sunday.

rest.what: Prospector 5 sank offshore Gabon, and five people remain unaccounted for as search-and-rescue operations continue.

lead.what: Serbia opened polling Sunday for its snap parliamentary election, with the main contenders described as close.

rest.what: Taiwan lifted its land warning at 2:30pm after Tropical Storm Champi moved away Saturday afternoon.

lead.what: Saudi Arabia reported intercepting a ballistic missile and drone as Riyadh’s reopened terminals returned to service.

rest.what: BW Energy said the MaBoMo facility was shut under standard procedure during drilling preparations.
